brand.name: TMF Line

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-semibold text-white
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Heavy whitespace discipline, generous padding, bento grid 2.0 structures.

navigation.cta: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium text-sm

hero.layout: Center aligned or bento-split depending on content. Use massive typography. Subtle gradient text for key words using bg-clip-text from-emerald-400 to-cyan-500.
hero.background: Radial gradient at top center (bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-zinc-800/40 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950) or generated abstract image.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 text-white hover:bg-emerald-600 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:border-zinc-500 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition-all

cards.style: bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-800/50 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:bg-zinc-900/60 transition-colors

forms.inputs: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none transition-all

calculators.layout: Card-based, split layout (inputs left, results right). Use sliders (Radix/shadcn) with emerald accents.
calculators.result_display: Massive font-mono for numbers, glowing text-emerald-400, wrapped in a glassmorphic result box.

accordions_faq.style: Border-b border-zinc-800. Headers text-lg text-zinc-200 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors. Content text-zinc-400.

stat_strips.style: Grid layout, mono font for numbers (text-4xl text-white), small uppercase tracking-widest for labels (text-xs text-zinc-500). Border separators between items.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle border color shifts, slight brightness increase on surfaces.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up (y: 20 -> 0) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active/click. Inputs glow on focus.

specs.tool: Gemini Nano Banana (or similar Image Generation Tool)
specs.aesthetic: Dark, premium fintech, architectural, abstract geometric, subtle emerald/blue edge lighting.

prompts.prompt: Abstract 3D glassmorphic geometric shapes floating in dark space, subtle emerald and blue edge lighting, premium fintech aesthetic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, sleek and corporate, wide landscape format 16:9

Wide-angle photograph of a modern glass office interior at night, overlooking a glowing city skyline, emerald and cool blue ambient lighting, premium corporate feel, no people, cinematic depth of field, 16:9
Close up architectural details of a brutalist premium building intersecting with glass, deep shadows, subtle cool blue lighting, high contrast, professional, dark background, 16:9
Silhouette of two executives walking in a sleek dark premium office corridor, illuminated by soft blue and emerald strip lighting, highly professional, mysterious and upscale, wide landscape 16:9
Macro photography of a sleek crystal prism refracting a single beam of emerald green light against a pitch black background, symbolizing financial clarity, ultra sharp, 16:9
Dark matte metallic surface with a very subtle microscopic grid pattern, high-end industrial design texture, dark grey, soft ambient lighting, 16:9
Soft volumetric fog in a dark studio illuminated by a single sleek vertical LED bar in emerald blue, minimal, negative space, premium aesthetic, 16:9
Abstract topographical map lines glowing faintly in emerald green on a deep black background, tech and finance connection metaphor, ultra minimal, 16:9

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-home-link', data-testid='hero-cta-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-first Vercel/Linear aesthetic with heavy use of zinc/neutral colors and emerald/cyan accents.
Do not use generic SaaS blocks. Build bento grids and custom glassmorphic cards.
Use Geist font or standard Tailwind sans (configured beautifully). Avoid Inter if possible by using custom @font-face or next/font.
Build calculators with clear visual state changes and use mono-fonts for numbers.
Implement the SVG logo exactly as provided in brand.logo_concept.implementation.

Use the fallback_urls for images. The prompt generation quotas failed for Gemini, so use these Unsplash premium dark-architecture/abstract images as placeholders, or trigger Gemini later if quota allows.
Avoid purple gradients. Stick exactly to the Emerald-Blue (#10B981 to #0EA5E9) palette.
